newsitem.title: POLAND: Nomura ups Wedel EPS forecast.
newsitem.headline: Nomura ups Wedel EPS forecast.

text.p: Nomura Equity Research has increased its 1997 and 1998 earnings per share forecasts for Polish confectioner Wedel SA to 9.2 and 13.4 zlotys from five and seven zlotys respectively, Nomura said in a report.

"Our new forecasts are significantly above our previous estimates...which had not anticipated such explosive growth in salty snacks and were based on a more gradual recovery in the company's traditional products," the report said.

The report, which was dated January 31 and maintained a hold rating, said Wedel should continue to report steady expansion in chocolate and biscuits and strong volume growth in salty snacks, with profit growth remaining strong.
Nomura saw Wedel, whose full name is E Wedel Zaklady Przemyslu Cukierniczego SA, lifting net profit to 55 million zlotys this year and 80 million zlotys next year from 40.8 million zlotys in 1996.
It said Wedel was a strong hold because its valuation remained high despite the firm's 53 percent net-profit jump last year, which was buoyed by a sales increase of 41 percent to 650 million zlotys.
Nomura saw sales of the firm, which is 83-percent controlled by PepsiCo Inc, rising to 880 million zlotys this year and 1.2 billion zlotys in 1998.
Wedel shares cost 147 zlotys at the time of the report and closed at 187 zlotys on Friday. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
